import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline


# Kernel source for scalar multiplication (A * s)
scalar_mul_kernel_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void scalar_mul_kernel(const float* A, const float* s_ptr, float* out, int total_elements) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < total_elements) {
        out[idx] = A[idx] * s_ptr[0];
    }
}

torch::Tensor matrix_scalar_mul_cuda(torch::Tensor A, float s) {
    auto size = A.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(A);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    // Allocate a temporary tensor on the device holding the scalar.
    auto s_tensor = torch.tensor([s], device=A.device);
    scalar_mul_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(A.data_ptr<float>(), s_tensor.data_ptr<float()>, out.data_ptr<float()>, size);

    return out;
}
"""

# C++ source for function signature
matrix_scalar_mul_cpp_source = "torch::Tensor matrix_scalar_mul_cuda(torch::Tensor A, float s);"

elementwise_matrix_scalar_mul = load_inline(
    name="matrix_scalar_mul",
    cpp_sources=matrix_scalar_mul_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=scalar_mul_kernel_source,
    functions=["matrix_scalar_mul_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[],
    extra_ldflags=[],
)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.matrix_scalar_mul = elementwise_matrix_scalar_mul

    def forward(self, A: torch.Tensor, s: float) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Performs matrix-scalar multiplication: C = A * s
        Args:
            A: Input matrix of shape (M, N)
            s: Scalar value
        Returns:
            C: Resulting matrix of shape (M, N)
        """
        return self.matrix_scalar_mul(A, s)
